# Tilt

> An offline neon arcade for iOS, Android and the web, built with Expo, React Native Skia and Reanimated: six small games with no network and no account. Scores stay on the device.

## Games

- [Stack](https://tilt-arcade-77n.pages.dev/play/stack): tap when the sliding block lines up; overhang is cut away
- [Orbit](https://tilt-arcade-77n.pages.dev/play/orbit): hold to circle a planet, release to fly to the next
- [Breakout](https://tilt-arcade-77n.pages.dev/play/breakout): drag the paddle and clear the wall
- [Slide](https://tilt-arcade-77n.pages.dev/play/slide): swipe so equal tiles merge
- [Trace](https://tilt-arcade-77n.pages.dev/play/trace): draw a road from the pad to the goal and ride it
- [Simon](https://tilt-arcade-77n.pages.dev/play/simon): watch four pads light up and play the sequence back

## Other pages

- [Cabinet](https://tilt-arcade-77n.pages.dev/): all six machines
- [High scores](https://tilt-arcade-77n.pages.dev/scores)
- [Settings](https://tilt-arcade-77n.pages.dev/settings): sound, haptics and reduced motion
